expected: The three Studio-origin document surfaces reach the realm that owns the save path. The diagnosis bisected the whole chain from the child store mutation to the reopen carrier, and every link downstream of the push was found GREEN when driven directly (probes B/C/D/D2/E). The remaining link — the child PUSH WIRING in PhysicsPaintStudio.tsx — has two drop shapes, and the three pins assert the contracts that remove them: a pending change is consumed only after a push with a confirmed mode (PIN 1 close path, PIN 2 both scheduler paths), and a failed push re-arms the push guard instead of latching that content away (PIN 3).
actual: 3 pre-fix failures, exactly the three planned pins, each naming the diagnosed mechanism. PIN 1 fails AssertionError: expected 92 to be greater than 229 — in flushDocumentSyncRef.current the pending flag is cleared at offset 92, BEFORE the push-mode gate at offset 229 (base PhysicsPaintStudio.tsx:3983 clears, :3986 gates). PIN 2 fails AssertionError: expected 330 to be greater than 473 — the same clear-before-gate shape in the non-gesture tryFlush body (base :4004 clears, :4007 gates). PIN 3 fails AssertionError: the pushLiveProjection source contains no re-arm of documentSyncPushGuardRef — the guard latches lastPushedFingerprint before the send resolves (documentSyncPushGuard.ts:44-48) and pushLiveProjection's .catch at :3957 swallows the failure, so a failed send suppresses that content for the rest of the session (T-260921-e21-03).

verdicts.link: child push wiring (PROBE A) — PhysicsPaintStudio.tsx:3981-3989 and :3953-3966
verdicts.evidence: The mutation itself is NOT child-realm-only: setPhotoReferenceSource (efxPaintStore.ts:1129-1176) writes _documents, bumps documentRevision and calls _notifyChange(), and PROBE A observed the child emit the reference on the wire (wireHasPhotoRef true) and the parent apply accept it (applied.photoReference.sourceFrameRefs = ['ref-photo-1']). The loss is at the WIRING that decides whether the push is attempted: flushDocumentSyncRef.current clears documentSyncDirty at :3983 and only THEN reads the bridge mode at :3986, so a change pending while bridgeModeRef.current is neither 'Tauri' nor 'Browser fallback' (usePhysicsPaintBridgeMode initialises to 'Unavailable' until detectPhysicsPaintBridgeMode resolves) is cleared with no push, and nothing re-marks it (the version does not bump again). Second shape on the same link: documentSyncPushGuard.evaluate latches lastPushedFingerprint BEFORE the send resolves (documentSyncPushGuard.ts:44-48) and pushLiveProjection's .catch at :3957 swallows a failed send, so that content is permanently suppressed for the session (T-260921-e21-03).
